#### What's great

I integrated Zernio's API and MCP into my Claude Copilot and Claude Code setup, and it filled a gap I'd been working around for a while. The connection is clean, the MCP responds reliably, and it slots into an AI-assisted development workflow without extra configuration overhead.

#### What needs improvement

A few more real-world examples would help speed up the learning curve. Nothing that blocked me, but it would make onboarding even smoother.
